defs.def: a time when a particular situation makes it possible to do or achieve sth 机会；时机

ex.s: ● Treat mistakes as opportunities.
ex.t: ● 把错误当作机会。

ex.s: However, I soon found that by doing so, I might be losing something more important: the opportunity to share a small part of my cultural identity.
ex.t: 然而我很快发现，这样做我可能正在失去更重要的东西：分享自己文化身份一小部分的机会。

ex.s: Nevertheless, this interview wasn’t a wasted opportunity.
ex.t: 尽管如此，这次面试并非浪费的机会。

ex.s: The Carlow Autumn Walking Festival is a great opportunity for the beginner, experienced or advanced walker to enjoy the challenges of Carlow’s mountain hikes or the peace of its woodland walks.
ex.t: Carlow秋季徒步节是初学者、有经验或高阶徒步者享受Carlow山地徒步挑战或林间漫步宁静的绝佳机会。

ex.s: It gives us an opportunity to learn from another person’s experience and it can shape, strengthen or challenge our opinions and values.
ex.t: 它给了我们一个从他人经历中学习的机会，并且能够塑造、强化或挑战我们的观点和价值观。

ex.s: By offering us more opportunities to know people.
ex.t: 通过给我们提供更多认识人的机会。

ex.s: Rather than setting plans in stone, I’ve learned that sometimes I need to take the opportunities that are offered, even if they don’t sound perfect at the time, and make the most of them.
ex.t: 与其把计划定死，我学到了有时候我需要抓住提供的机会，即使当时听起来并不完美，并且充分利用它们。

ex.s: It’s an opportunity to deepen your understanding of the key points from lecture materials while you are applying your skills to solve problems.
ex.t: 这是一个深化你对讲座材料要点理解的机会，同时你运用技能解决问题。

ex.s: Looking back, I now see that this would be the first in a series of timely opportunities that my old self would have let pass, but that this new and more confident Alice enthusiastically seized.
ex.t: 回想起来，我现在看到，这将是我以前的自我本来会放弃的一系列及时机会中的第一个机会，但是这个新的和更加自信的爱丽丝却热情地抓住了机会。

ex.s: They say good things come to those who wait; I say: grab every opportunity with everything you have and be impatient.
ex.t: 他们说好事会降临在懂得等待的人身上；我说：用你拥有的一切抓住每个机会，并且要迫不及待。

ex.s: Tom is proud of his design and excited to be selling the Fun Bottle on his website and in stores but this 15-year-old is most proud of the opportunities that Fun Bottle presents to others.
ex.t: Tom对他的设计感到自豪，也很兴奋能在他的网站和商店销售Fun Bottle，但这位15岁少年最引以为豪的是Fun Bottle为他人带来的机会。

ex.s: Tom is most proud of the opportunities that Fun Bottle presents to others because he not only provides healthy alternatives to sugary drinks but also donates all the profits to the OHG.
ex.t: Tom最引以为豪Fun Bottle为他人的带来机会是因为他不仅提供了含糖饮料的健康替代品，还将所有利润捐赠给了OHG。

ex.s: 30    simply satisfying a material need, he has provided an opportunity for kids in his neighborhood to learn how to fix their own bikes.
ex.t: 30    不仅满足了物质需求他还为社区里的孩子们提供了一个学习修理自己自行车的机会。

ex.s: giving up an opportunity
ex.t: 放弃一个机会

ex.s: Others also looked at the phone boxes and saw business opportunities.
ex.t: 当地组织可以用1英镑的价格认领它们，并安装除颤仪以备紧急情况使用。

ex.s: If you have difficulties reading, ask about special reading opportunities.
ex.t: 如果你阅读有困难，可以询问是否有专门的阅读机会。

ex.s: This new start gave me an opportunity to redefine myself and discover an entirely new version of "cool".
ex.t: 这个新的开始让我有机会重新定义自己，并发现一个全新的“酷”的版本。

ex.s: Through the Summer Employment Opportunities program, students are hired each year in a variety of summer positions across the Provincial Public Service, its related agencies and community groups.
ex.t: 通过“暑期就业机会”项目，学生每年会被雇用到省内公共服务部门、相关机构和社区团体的各种暑期岗位。

ex.s: It offers more summer job opportunities.
ex.t: 它提供了更多的夏季就业机会。

ex.s: Summer Employment Opportunities.
ex.t: 夏季就业机会项目。

ex.s: "Being liked creates opportunities for learning and for new kinds of life experiences that help somebody gain an advantage, ” he said.
ex.t: “被人喜欢会创造学习和新型生活体验的机会，帮助人获得优势，”他说。

ex.s: February 19 A committee of teachers will evaluate materials and give opinions．Students then have an opportunity to improve their products．
ex.t: 2月19日 教师委员会将评估材料并给出意见。学生随后有机会改进作品。

ex.s: Most of us， in fact， progressively narrow the variety of our lives． We succeed in our field of specialization and then become trapped in it． Nothing surprises us． We lose our sense of wonder． But， if we are willing to learn， the opportunities are everywhere．
ex.t: 事实上，我们大多数人都在逐渐缩小生活的多样性。我们在自己的专业领域取得成功，然后便被困其中。没有什么能让我们感到惊讶。我们失去了好奇心。但是，如果我们愿意学习，机会无处不在。

ex.s: Miss the opportunity to succeed．
ex.t: C. 错过了成功的机会。

ex.s: Opportunity favors those with a curious mind．
ex.t: C．机会青睐那些有好奇心的人。

ex.s: Opportunity awaits those with a cautious mind．
ex.t: D．机会等待有谨慎之心的人。

ex.s: Small companies could get more opportunities.
ex.t: 小公司可以获得更多机会。

ex.s: Mohammed Rezwan saw opportunity where others saw only disaster.
ex.t: 穆罕默德·雷兹万在别人只看到灾难的地方看到了机遇。

ex.s: It's a fantastic opportunity for new students to get to know the school and the other students.
ex.t: 对于新生来说，这是一个绝好的机会来了解学校和其他同学。

ex.s: Rewards of the job Wildlife photographers have the opportunity to see animals in the wild and help improve people’s understanding of them.
ex.t: 工作的回报：野生动物摄影师有机会在野外看到动物，并帮助提高人们对它们的理解。

ex.s: A family day out is an opportunity to put aside work, school and other commitments and spend quality time together.
ex.t: 家庭出游是一个把工作、学业和其他事务放到一边，共度美好时光的机会。

ex.s: It was not only for the delicious food that we seldom got to eat, but for the opportunity to have our whole family gathered together.
ex.t: 我们 seldom 能吃到这些美味食物，不仅为了食物，也为了全家团聚的机会。

ex.s: I try to take every opportunity to get outside and admire the natural world.
ex.t: 我尽量抓住每个机会到户外欣赏自然世界。
